ai.overview: The Vegas Golden Knights put their lineal championship belt on the line when they host the Utah Mammoth on November 11, 2026. Vegas has yet to defend the belt in this reign, making this their first defense opportunity. The belt passes to whoever wins, with no committee or poll involved—just the result on the ice.
